setup.headphones_body: Without headphones the mic picks up the backing track through your speakers and causes false detections.
setup.quiet_body: Background noise causes false note detections. Close doors and turn off any music.
setup.which_jack: Which jack is your guitar plugged into?
setup.native_hint: Native low-latency capture — bypasses the browser entirely. Plug your guitar straight into the interface above.
setup.output_hint: Should match the interface above so audio and capture use the same device.
setup.output_hint_asio4all: ASIO4ALL locks your whole interface, outputs included, so the metronome can't play through it. Pick a different output here (e.g. your computer's speakers), or turn off the interface's output in the ASIO4ALL panel and keep only its input.
setup.before_start_body: Make sure your interface is selected as the browser's microphone input and your guitar is plugged in. You'll set the gain level on the next screen.

output_stall.title: The metronome can't play
output_stall.body: Your audio driver is holding the output the app plays through, so the metronome and backing tracks can't be heard. Pick another output, e.g. your computer's speakers or headphone jack.
output_stall.asio4all: Using ASIO4ALL? In its panel, keep only your interface's input switched on, and make sure no other sound card is ticked there.

source.title: Guitar Calibration
source.question: How is your guitar connected to the computer?
source.mic_desc: Built-in laptop mic or external USB mic
source.mobile_body: Your phone's microphone will listen to your guitar.
source.mobile_headphones: Plug in headphones if you can
source.mobile_headphones_body: Without them the mic also hears the app's sounds from your speaker, and note detection gets less accurate.

summary.title: All Done
summary.body: Your calibration is complete. If you feel the detection is still slightly off, consider re-tuning your guitar or adjusting the input sensitivity.

permission.title: Microphone Access
permission.body: To detect your guitar notes, we need permission to use your audio input. No audio is ever recorded or sent to any server.

error.title: Microphone blocked
error.body: Please allow microphone access in your browser settings, then try again.

choice.title: Existing Calibration
choice.old: This calibration is over 30 days old — consider recalibrating for best accuracy.

mic_mode.exam_body: This module requires microphone setup. Enable your microphone so the system can evaluate your playing during the exam.
mic_mode.body: This plan contains tablature exercises. Enable your microphone so the system can listen to your guitar and score your playing in real time.
